style: clean HD 2D anime-inspired Form Agent, solid #FF00FF background, no text/labels/UI/arrows, sell the cue with pose + camera + lighting emphasis only

idle.focus: Tall stacked posture: ribs over pelvis, soft knee unlock, arms relaxed. Subtle breathing idle only.

curl-both.focus: Elbows pinned to ribs like hinges; only forearms move. Upper arms stay glued to torso.

curl-alt.focus: Strict alternating: one arm curls while the other stays locked long; torso does not rock.

curl-seated.focus: Seated upright; elbows stay under shoulders against the torso; no hip drive off the bench.

kickback.focus: Upper arm locked parallel to floor; only the forearm hinges. Elbow height never drops.

dip.focus: Shoulders down and back; elbows track rearward (not flared wide); chest proud, no shrug.

oh-ext.focus: Upper arms stay vertical beside head; only forearms fold. Elbows point up, not forward.

press-flat.focus: Wrists stacked over elbows; bar/DB path vertical over mid-chest; shoulder blades pinned to bench.

press-incline.focus: Incline angle readable; press path slightly up/back over upper chest; no low flat-bench path.

press-decline.focus: Decline angle readable; path over lower chest; hips secured, controlled lockout.

press-floor.focus: Triceps stop when upper arms touch floor; no shoulder dump. Elbows ~45° from torso.

press-squeeze.focus: Dumbbells pressed together the whole rep; constant inward squeeze through the lockout.

press-shoulder.focus: Ribs down, glutes under; press straight up (not forward). Elbows under wrists.

fly.focus: Soft elbow bend fixed; wide arc from open to hug; wrists above elbows, not a press.

pullover.focus: Shoulders stay packed; long arc from overhead to hips with soft elbows; ribs do not flare hard.

row-wide.focus: Pull elbows out wide toward lower chest; squeeze shoulder blades together at the peak.

row-bent.focus: Hip hinge held flat-backed; bar/DB path to lower ribs; no standing up between reps.

row-one.focus: Torso square to floor on bench support; elbow drives back close to body; no torso twist.

row-close.focus: Elbows tuck tight to ribs; pull to stomach; narrow grip readable.

row-incline.focus: Chest glued to incline pad; pull without yanking torso off the pad.

row-squeeze.focus: Peak hold with hard scapular pinch; elbows behind torso plane briefly.

row-seated.focus: Sit tall, pull handle to belly; torso barely rocks; squeeze mid-back at end.

leg-press.focus: Feet mid-platform; knees track over toes; lower until ~90° without pelvis tucking under.

leg-ext.focus: Hips planted in seat; full knee extension without hip popping up; controlled lower.

squat.focus: Hips back+down, knees track toes, torso braced; depth near parallel with heels down.

split-squat.focus: Front shin mostly vertical; back knee drops straight down; torso upright, no forward collapse.
mustShow: rear foot elevated or split stance

pulldown.focus: Pull bar to upper chest; elbows drive down/back; slight lean only, no heavy swing.

pullup.focus: Dead hang to chin-over-bar; shoulders pack down before pull; no kipping.

rdl.focus: Soft knees fixed; hips shoot back; flat back from head to tail; bar stays close to legs.

bridge.focus: Ribs down, posterior pelvic tilt; squeeze glutes at top; avoid over-arching lumbar.

rev-fly.focus: Soft elbows; open arms wide in rear-delt plane; squeeze upper back, not shrugging traps.

dead-bug.focus: Low back pressed to floor the whole time; opposite arm/leg extend slowly without arching.
